# n8n Localization

> Multilingual interface localization installer for self-hosted n8n, including Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, and Spanish. It does not contain or install n8n itself.

Repository: https://github.com/Melaszzzz/n8n-localization
License: PolyForm Strict 1.0.0 from v0.4.0; unmodified noncommercial use only unless separately authorized
Platforms: macOS, Windows, Linux
Deployment: self-hosted n8n only; n8n Cloud is not supported
Locales:
- zh-CN: Simplified Chinese, complete
- zh-TW: Traditional Chinese (Taiwan), preview
- es: Spanish, preview

Preview means full automated key coverage with pending proficient-speaker UI review.

Install:
npx --yes --package git+https://github.com/Melaszzzz/n8n-localization.git n8n-localize --locale zh-CN

List locales:
npx --yes --package git+https://github.com/Melaszzzz/n8n-localization.git n8n-localize --list-locales

Uninstall:
npx --yes --package git+https://github.com/Melaszzzz/n8n-localization.git n8n-localize --locale zh-CN --uninstall

Detailed machine-oriented instructions: AI_INSTALL.md
Human documentation: README.md (English) and README.zh-CN.md (Chinese)
